verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents processing in 150+ currencies and getting paid in local currencies with fast settlement. An FX rates API exposes the rates it uses for acquiring, and reconciliation docs list an 'Exchange (FX) rate fee' category alongside settlement breakdown reports, so FX handling is visible to the merchant. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that funds settle to the merchant's bank in a chosen settlement currency, detail on FX markup and how indicative rates relate to applied rates, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can charge customers in their local currencies and settle to my bank in mine with transparent FX handling

citations.quote: Get paid in local currencies, settle funds fast, and gain valuable insights.
Use the FX rates API to retrieve the indicative foreign exchange (FX) rates that Checkout.com uses for acquiring and card payouts.
